issues.title: Allow longer properties to be defined (textarea)
issues.body:
We could allow more descriptive content associated with map symbols if the Game Designer was able to specify that a property would require a text area.

We already have `StringProperty`

We could extend it to include a `lines?: number` attribute. This would indicate how many vertical lines to assign to the text box.
